page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 208 dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CL vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 3072.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 14.77 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile represents a high-density memory configuration designed to consolidate massive in-memory datasets onto a single physical host, reducing the overhead associated with multi-node clustering.

The ecs.re6.52xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Suitable use cases include large-scale in-memory databases, real-time data analytics, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and large caching layers that require massive RAM capacity alongside substantial dedicated compute resources.
